acceptance: /tmp/archie_health/status.json is produced by Guardian
a killed producer makes consumers fail CLOSED not open
injected ORANGE actually halts a training admission
T-003.evidence: Producer wired: forge-guardian now writes /tmp/archie_health/status.json (state/swap_gib/halt/gpu_jobs/producer), verified live and fresh at age 0s. Four consumers inverted to fail CLOSED: missing->UNKNOWN, stale(>600s)->STALE, unparseable->UNREADABLE, healthy->GREEN, ORANGE passes through. Gate tools/selfconsist/test_health_fails_closed.py 25/25, extracting the LIVE health() via ast rather than restating the rule. Positive control: the OLD function run under the same missing-file condition returns GREEN, proving a behaviour change not a passing state. End-to-end: HALT flag propagates within one poll and clears.
T-003.notes: The Law-7 admission system depends on a file NOTHING writes. Five consumers return {state:GREEN} on a missing file. forge-guardian already computes this exact state - wire it as the producer and invert the fail direction.
T-003.title: Health signal has 17 consumers, no producer, and 5 fail OPEN to GREEN
